name: Asset Manager Portfolio Analyst
description: Analyzes asset manager portfolios, identifies commonly and uncommonly held companies, and finds managers sharing investments.
system_prompt: Analyze asset manager portfolios to identify unique and shared company investments. When responding, be analytical and provide clear, structured insights.

tools.name: Get Companies by Manager
tools.description: Retrieves a list of companies owned by a specific asset manager, including shares and value.

config.template: MATCH (m:Manager)-[o:OWNS]->(c:Company) WHERE m.managerName = $managerName RETURN c.companyName AS companyName, o.shares AS shares, o.value AS value ORDER BY o.shares DESC LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: managerName
parameters.description: The exact name of the asset manager.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of companies to return.

tools.name: Get Managers Owning Company
tools.description: Finds all asset managers that own a specific company.

config.template: MATCH (m:Manager)-[:OWNS]->(c:Company) WHERE c.companyName = $companyName RETURN m.managerName AS managerName ORDER BY managerName LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: companyName
parameters.description: The exact name of the company.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of managers to return.

tools.name: Find Manager's Uncommon Companies
tools.description: For a given manager, identifies companies they own that are held by a relatively small number of other managers. 'Uncommon' is defined by a maximum number of total owners for the company.

config.template: MATCH (m:Manager {managerName: $managerName})-[ownsRel:OWNS]->(c:Company) WITH c, ownsRel, m.managerName AS managerName MATCH (otherManagers:Manager)-[:OWNS]->(c) WITH c, ownsRel, managerName, count(DISTINCT otherManagers) AS totalOwners WHERE totalOwners <= $maxTotalOwners RETURN c.companyName AS companyName, totalOwners, ownsRel.shares AS shares, ownsRel.value AS value ORDER BY totalOwners ASC, companyName ASC LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: managerName
parameters.description: The exact name of the asset manager.

parameters.name: maxTotalOwners
parameters.description: Maximum number of total managers owning a company for it to be considered 'uncommon'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of uncommon companies to return.

tools.name: Find Managers Sharing Uncommon Companies
tools.description: Identifies companies that are owned by a small number of managers (uncommon), and lists all managers who own those companies. Requires at least two managers to be considered 'shared'.

config.template: MATCH (c:Company)<-[:OWNS]-(m:Manager) WITH c, collect(DISTINCT m.managerName) AS owningManagers WHERE size(owningManagers) >= 2 AND size(owningManagers) <= $maxOwnersCount RETURN c.companyName AS companyName, owningManagers, size(owningManagers) AS numberOfOwners ORDER BY numberOfOwners ASC, companyName ASC LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: maxOwnersCount
parameters.description: Maximum number of managers that can own a company for it to be considered 'uncommon' and shared.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of shared uncommon companies to return.

tools.name: Natural Language to Cypher Tool
tools.description: A general-purpose, free-form Text-to-Cypher tool that converts natural language questions into Cypher queries, executes them, and returns the results. Use this option when no specialized tool (e.g. for aggregation or domain-specific logic) is more appropriate.
